rationale: Runtime reports under reports/runtime/ are advisory inputs to governance gates; they reflect last-known staging probes against the shared ACA environment. They are NOT the truth source for productCatalog/inventory/registry alignment. Production runtime authority requires live, signed probes against owned production domains and is currently out of scope (no production environment provisioned).

live-health-failure-matrix.json.notes: Bare JSON array of failure observations from staging probes. All entries are policyCritical=false advisory classifications. No code consumers detected; surface used for governance reporting only.

health-latest.json.notes: Embedded bootstrapEvidence=true flag confirms this is a seeded baseline, not a live signed probe. Used for governance display; not a gate authority.

post-redeploy-runtime-attestation-2026-0.notes: Attests orchestrator-api revision --0000022 reached Running/Healthy with /health=200 status=degraded, /ready=503 (readiness follow-up), /=404 (no root route by design). Generator reclassifies orchestrator-api from failing→degraded; validator inverse invariant 5b enforces this supersession.

live-health-post-redeploy-2026-05-12.jso.notes: Raw probe capture from 2026-05-12T06:39:15Z paired with the attestation file. Both share the same revision (--0000022) and image digest.

gateImpact.rationale: These artifacts inform but do not block release gates until a runtime authority pipeline is operational against owned production domains.
